Subject: Vertex Analytics — Supplier onboarding: bank verification & remittance format

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalizing Redwood as a vendor in our AP system and I wanted to confirm the forma t you prefer for remittance and how you want the wire/ACH fields returned in our EDI. Two quick asks: 

1) What fields do you need on the remittance line so our ERP (Coupa) maps payments to PO/Invoice correctly?
2) How do you prefer to receive ACH vs wire authorization docs (PDF upload to portal vs email)?

I’ve attached our supplier onboarding packet but happy to fill any Redwood-specific form if you have one. We’re targeting the first payable run the week of 9/20.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations
Vertex Analytics
(samir.k@vertex-analytics.com)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vertex Analytics — Supplier onboarding: bank verification & remittance format

Thanks Samir — welcome aboard. To speed this we need three things from you:

- Completed vendor banking form (template attached below) with account name, routing, account number, and SWIFT (for wires).
- W-9 (or W-8 if non-US)
- A sample remittance CSV showing how your ERP populates PO and invoice references (so our AP can map automatically).

Preferred delivery: upload the PDFs to the secure Drive link I’ll share, and copy Finance (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) on the reply. If you can’t upload, email PDFs are OK for first pass, but we’ll request signed DocuSign for wires.

Quick notes on remittance fields: our preferred mapping is: PO# -> remit_reference (PO), Invoice# -> invoice_reference, Supplier reference -> supplier_id. If you include an internal invoice line with the invoice amount and currency it helps avoid manual reconciliation.

Could you send the completed files by EOD Monday (9/13)? I’ll route to Finance for micro-deposit verification and wire setup.

Best,
Olga
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_vendor_banking_template.pdf (12 KB)

Subject: Re: Vertex Analytics — Supplier onboarding: bank verification & remittance format

Olga — attaching the completed items per your template.

Files included:
- vertex_wire_authorization.pdf (filled and signed)
- vertex_w9.pdf
- vertex_remit_sample.csv (exports from Coupa showing PO/Invoice -> remit fields)

Alicia (cc) will be our day-to-day contact if you need invoice samples or an additional format. We put PO in the first remittance column and Invoice in the second column; the CSV header is: remit_reference, invoice_reference, amount, currency, payment_date.

Let me know if anything else is required to schedule the micro-deposits. We’d like ACH if possible; wires only for cross-border.

Thanks,
Samir
